cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_shots_attempted
FROM nba.shot_detail;
cases.summary: Counts all field goal attempts (made + missed) recorded in nba.shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season, the only season loaded.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS games_covered FROM nba.shot_detail
cases.summary: Counts distinct game_id values in shot_detail (which covers all games in the loaded 2023-24 regular season dataset).

cases.sql: SELECT shot_zone_basic, COUNT(*) AS attempt_count FROM nba.shot_detail GROUP BY shot_zone_basic ORDER BY attempt_count DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts all field-goal attempts (made and missed) in shot_detail grouped by shot_zone_basic, ranked by frequency, for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS three_pointers_made
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE season = 2023
  AND season_type = 'regular'
  AND shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
  AND shot_made_flag = 1;
cases.summary: Counts made three-point field goals in shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shot_attempts FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE player_name = 'Stephen Curry' AND season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular'
cases.summary: Counts all field goal attempts (made + missed) by Stephen Curry in shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season, the only season loaded (this excludes free throws, since shot_detail only covers field goals).

cases.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, COUNT(*) AS fg_attempts FROM nba.shot_detail GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY fg_attempts DESC LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Counts total field goal attempts (made + missed shots) per player from shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season, ranked descending, top 10. Note: this counts field goal attempts only, not free throws.

cases.sql: SELECT shot_zone_basic, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 1) AS fg_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE player_name = 'Nikola Jokic' AND season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' GROUP BY shot_zone_basic ORDER BY attempts DESC
cases.summary: Computes Nikola Jokic's field goal percentage (made/attempted) for each shot zone (shot_zone_basic) in the 2023-24 regular season, using nba.shot_detail (field goals only, no free throws).

cases.sql:
SELECT team_id, team_name, COUNT(*) AS three_point_attempts
FROM nba.shot_detail
WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal'
GROUP BY team_id, team_name
ORDER BY three_point_attempts DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Counts all 3PT field goal attempts (made + missed) in shot_detail grouped by team, for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS shot_attempts FROM nba.shot_detail GROUP BY period ORDER BY period;
cases.summary: Counts all field goal attempts (makes and misses) in nba.shot_detail grouped by period. Note this excludes free throws, which are not shots in this dataset.

cases.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS fg3_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200 ORDER BY fg3_pct DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Ranking players by 3PT% (made/attempted) from shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season, restricted to players with at least 200 three-point attempts.

cases.sql: SELECT game_id, game_date, player_name, team_name, period, minutes_remaining, seconds_remaining, shot_distance, shot_zone_basic, action_type FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_made_flag = 1 ORDER BY shot_distance DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Returns the made field goals with the greatest shot_distance (feet) recorded in shot_detail for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded), ordered longest first, limited to 10.

cases.sql: SELECT player2_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS assists FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE eventmsgtype = 1 AND player2_id <> 0 AND player2_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player2_name ORDER BY assists DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts assists as player2 on made field goals (eventmsgtype = 1) in nba.pbp_event, which is the only data available (2023-24 regular season only, no playoff data loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT player1_id, player1_name, COUNT(*) AS turnovers FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND eventmsgtype = 5 AND player1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name ORDER BY turnovers DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Counts turnover events (eventmsgtype = 5) grouped by the committing player (player1), excluding team-level turnovers where player1_name is NULL, for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT player1_id AS player_id, player1_name AS player_name, COUNT(*) AS ft_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ft_made, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS ft_pct FROM nba.pbp_event WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND eventmsgtype = 3 AND player1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 300 ORDER BY ft_pct DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: Computes free throw percentage per player using pbp_event rows with eventmsgtype = 3 (free throws), treating any description starting with 'MISS' as a miss and everything else as a make, restricted to players with at least 300 free throw attempts. Only the 2023-24 regular season is loaded, so this reflects that season only.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(shot_made_flag) AS makes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(shot_made_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS three_pt_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' AND period = 4 AND (minutes_remaining < 2 OR (minutes_remaining = 2 AND seconds_remaining = 0))
cases.summary: Three-point field-goal percentage for shots taken with 2:00 or less remaining in the 4th quarter of the 2023-24 regular season, computed as made 3PT shots divided by all 3PT attempts from nba.shot_detail (the only season/season_type loaded).

cases.sql: SELECT team_id, team_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3','Right Corner 3')) AS corner_three_attempts, COUNT(*) AS total_three_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shot_zone_basic IN ('Left Corner 3','Right Corner 3')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS corner_three_pct FROM nba.shot_detail WHERE shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' GROUP BY team_id, team_name ORDER BY corner_three_pct DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: For each team, computes the share of all 3-point attempts (2023-24 regular season) that came from the corner zones ('Left Corner 3' or 'Right Corner 3'), ranked descending. Only field-goal attempts are in this data (shot_detail), so this reflects shot location distribution, not scoring efficiency.

cases.sql:
WITH fg AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(CASE WHEN shot_type = '3PT Field Goal' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END) AS pts
  FROM nba.shot_detail
  WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND shot_made_flag = 1
  GROUP BY player_id, player_name
),
ft AS (
  SELECT player1_id AS player_id, player1_name AS player_name, COUNT(*) AS pts
  FROM nba.pbp_event
  WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'regular' AND eventmsgtype = 3
    AND COALESCE(homedescription, visitordescription, neutraldescription) NOT LIKE 'MISS%'
  GROUP BY player1_id, player1_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT player_id, player_name, pts FROM fg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, player_name, pts FROM ft
)
SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points
FROM combined
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 10;
cases.summary: Total points = made field goals (2 or 3 pts, from shot_detail) plus made free throws (1 pt each, from pbp_event where the description doesn't start with 'MISS'), for the 2023-24 regular season (the only season loaded). Ranked descending, top 10 shown.

"Best shooters" could mean several different things: overall field-goal percentage, three-point percentage, effective FG%, or high-volume scorers with strong efficiency. Which definition would you like — e.g. highest 3PT% with a minimum number of attempts, or highest overall FG% among high-volume shooters? Also note this data only covers the 2023-24 regular season and field goals only (no free throws), so it can't capture true shooting % including free throws.

"Clutch" isn't a defined metric in this data, and different reasonable definitions would give very different answers. Do you mean: (a) most points/makes scored in the final ~5 minutes of games that were within a few points, (b) highest field-goal percentage in that same late-and-close situation (with some minimum attempts), or (c) something else like game-winning shots specifically? I can build any of these from shot_detail + pbp_event (period, pctimestring, scoremargin), but need you to pick the definition since guessing would likely give a misleading leaderboard.

This database only contains the 2023-24 regular season (no prior season, no playoffs, no season-aggregate or biographical data), so there is no baseline to measure 'improvement' against. I can't compute a year-over-year or season-over-season change for any player. If you want, I could offer a proxy like comparing a player's shooting/scoring in the first half vs. second half of the 2023-24 season, but that's a different question than year-over-year improvement.

The database only contains the 2023-24 regular season (season=2023, season_type='regular'); no playoff data is loaded at all, so Jayson Tatum's 2024 playoff performance cannot be retrieved from this data.

The database only contains the 2023-24 regular season (season = 2023, season_type = 'regular'). There is no 2019 (or 2018-19) season data loaded, so a comparison across those two seasons cannot be made. I can show LeBron James's 2023-24 shooting splits alone if that would help, but that would only be one side of the comparison you asked for.

There is no player biographical data in this database (no height, weight, position, etc.), so I can't filter players by height. I can only give shot totals for all players from shot_detail if that would help.

This database has no awards, standings, or biographical data — only play-by-play events and shot detail for the 2023-24 regular season. It cannot tell you who won MVP. As a (rough, not equivalent) proxy, I could rank players by points scored or other event-derived stats for that season, but that isn't the same as the actual MVP award.

This database has no salary or payroll data at all — it only contains 2023-24 regular season play-by-play events and shot detail. There is no way to determine 'highest-paid' from event-grain box score data.
